rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING A SCHOOL MODERNIZATION AND INNOVATION PROGRAM FOR PUBLIC ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"School Modernization and Innovation Act of 2007\". This bill aims to institutionalize a comprehensive modernization program for public schools and to provide a mechanism for the private sector and for local government units to participate in the program. The bill also seeks to establish the School Modernization and Innovation Trust Fund which will augment regular appropriations under the General Appropriations Act.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE LEGITIMATION OF CHILDREN BORN TO PARENTS BELOW MARRYING AGE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Today, the incidents of children born out of wedlock to parents who are disqualified under the law to marry each other because of the issue of minority are still very common. To uphold the rights and dignity of these children, this bill provides for the legitimation of children born to parents below marrying age.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05279

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROGRAM FOR THE ACQUISITION OF SCHOOL SITES AND THE CONSTRUCTION, MAINTENANCE, REHABILITATION, AND REPAIR OF SCHOOL BUILDINGS IN THE PUBLIC ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS NATIONWIDE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"School Building Program Act of 2007\". This bill seeks to create a comprehensive program which will address the problem of classroom shortage. It carries a provision for a build-operate, build-lease-transfer, build-transfer, rehabilitate-operate-transfer and other contractual arragements that will allow the use of both government and private funds to finance the construction of school buildings. It is hoped that with the passage of the bill, class sizes will be reduced to a manageable level and thus result in the improvement in the quality of education.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07188

rows.author: E011
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC RETENTION BY THE BARANGAY OF ITS SHARE OF FIFTY PERCENT (50%) IN THE COMMUNITY TAX COLLECTED BY SAID BARANGAY, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 164 OF R.A. NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Section 164, par (c), subpar (2) of the Local Government Code of 1991 entitles barangay units to share up to fifty percent (50%) of their community tax collection. The section also provides that the share of the national government from the community tax collection shall be remitted by the city or municipality concerned within ten (10) days after the end of each quarter. It is silent as when the barangay shall receive its share of the community taxes. To correct the situation, the bill seeks to amend this provision to allow barangays to automatically retain their fifty percent (50%) share in the community tax collections and to remit the share of the city or municipality within ten (10) days after the end of each month.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2007-07-24

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A PROGRAM FOR THE CONTINUING EDUCATION OF COLLEGE TEACHERS, AMENDING FOR SUCH PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7784, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"AN ACT STRENGTHENING TEACHER EDUCATION IN THE PHILIPPINES BY ESTABLISHING CENTERS OF EXCELLENCE, CREATING A TEACHER EDUCATION COUNCIL FOR THE PURPOSE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFORE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The proposed bill seeks to institute a program for college teachers in private and public universities/colleges for the purpose of improving the quality of tertiary education in the country by means of upgrading the capability and competence of these teachers. The proposed training program shall focus on proper teaching methods and on other areas of study where continuing education is necessary.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2007-07-24

rows.author: E011
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE TAX ON IDLE LANDS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 236 OF R.A. NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The country has a total land area of 30 million hectares, 47% of which are classified as alienable and disposable. The bill seeks to increase the ceiling tax on idle lands from five percent (5%) to ten percent (10%) to give local government units more flexibility in the imposition of the tax. The current maximum of five percent (5%) has not proven to be deterrent against the non-utilization of agricultural lands for productive purposes. The idle land tax is in addition to the basic real property tax.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2007-07-24

rows.abstract: \"Public School Teachers' Insurance Act of 2007\".  This bill seeks to improve the plight of teachers by improving the benefits afforded to them to encourage the best minds to join the teaching profession. Specifically, this provides additional insurance benefits to public school teachers, over and above the benefits granted by the Government Service Insurance System.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL BRANCHES, SUBDIVISIONS, INSTRUMENTALITIES, AND AGENCIES OF THE GOVERNMENT, INCLUDING GOVERNMENT-OWNED OR-CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS OR THEIR SUBSIDIARIES TO DIVULGE THE IDENTITY OF HIRED FOREIGN CONSULTANTS, THE NATURE OF THEIR WORK AND THEIR COMPENSATION, PERKS, AND OTHER PRIVILEGES, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES IN CASE OF VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to require full disclosure of the identity, nature or work and compensation of foreign consultants hired or retained by the government, its agencies and instrumentalities. It aims: a. to inform the public of the amount being used to pay consultants hired by the government; b. to appraise the public of whether or not the services of these consultants are indispensable and cannot be rendered by our local experts; and c. to enlighten the public of the personalities providing expert advice and support to the government.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE MARINE POLLUTION DECREE OF 1974
rows.abstract: Presidential Decree No. 600 declares as unlawful the throwing, discharge or deposit of any refuse matter of any kind or description. However, the penalty of a fine of five hundred pesos (P500.00) or imprisonment of not more than one (1) year is not at all parallel to the concomitant damage to our waters. This measure seeks to increase the penalty for unlawful dumping and holds the president, manager or director of a corporation or partnership liable for such acts. It sets the guidelines under which dumping may be allowed.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07187

rows.author: E011
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING BONDS ISSUED BY THE LAND BANK OF THE PHILIPPINES FOR LAND ACQUISITIONS FROM PAYMENT OF THE TWENTY PERCENT (20%) FINAL TAX ON INTEREST INCOME, AMENDING FOR THE SAID PURPOSE SECTION 24(B)(1) OF REPUBLIC ACT 8424, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE TAX REFORM ACT OF 1997
rows.abstract: In the implementation of the Land Reform Law, the contemplated protection of the just share for the landowners did not actually materialize. In most cases, only the productive portions of the lands were bought, leaving the landowners with unproductive and undesirable portions of the land. To redress a perceived social wrong, this bill proposes to exempt interest earnings on Land Bank notes paid to landowners from the payment of withholding tax.

rows.abstract: Under the present system, barangays have to literally beg for their rightful share of the national taxes. rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING AN ADVANCED STUDIES DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM FOR EXCEPTIONAL EMPLOYEES FROM OTHER GOVERNMENT AND THE PRIVATE SECTOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"The Pensionado Act of 2007\".  The bill proposes to establish a program for exceptionally able and highly motivated employees to undertake advanced studies in a branch of science, technology or related fields of learning that would contribute to the development and progress of the country.  The program shall pool together all fellowships, scholarships, training grants sponsored by foreign governments and agencies.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE SUBMISSION TO CONGRESS OF THE CORPORATE BUDGET OF ALL GOVERNMENT-OWNED OR CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS, THEIR SUBSIDIARIES AND AFFILIATES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE, SECTION 13 OF PD 1177, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'BUDGETARY REFORM ACT OF 1977'

rows.title_full: AN ACT GIVING OFFENDERS THE FULLEST BENEFIT OF PREVENTIVE IMPRISONMENT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 29 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3815, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to grant an offender full credit for his preventive imprisonment as a general rule without any written agreement.  It also provides that if the prisoner does not agree to abide by the disciplinary rules imposed upon convicted prisoners, he shall do so in writing and then be entitled to only four-fifths (4/5) of the time during which he has undergone preventive imprisonment.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06943

rows.author: E011
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT 8239, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'PHILIPPINE PASSPORT ACT OF 2007' AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to:  a) simplify pasport documentation requirements and processes; b) add grounds for its amendment, suspension and revocation; c) rally for the issuance of passports using tamper proof and the latest data encryption technology; and d) provide stiffer penalties against the perpetrators of the proliferation of fake passports.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on FOREIGN AFFAIRS since 2007-07-24

rows.author: E011
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR BENEFITS TO MILITARY DEPENDENTS, CREATING THE MILITARY DEPENDENTS WELFARE OFFICE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2007-07-24

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE GRANT OF STUDENT FARE DISCOUNT PRIVILEGES ON LAND, WATER AND AIR TRANSPORT UTILITIES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.abstract: \"The Real Estate Investment Trust Act of 2007\".  The bill provides for the legal framework whereby real estate investment trusts may be allowed to invest in real estate, whether freehold or leasehold, in or out of the country; real estate related assets; listed or unlisted debt securities and listed shares issued by local or foreign non-property corporations; government securities issued on behalf of the Philippine government or governments of other countries; and cash and cash equivalent items.

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING AN ELECTIVE OFFICIAL IPSO FACTO RESIGNED FROM HIS ELECTIVE OFFICE UPON THE FILING OF HIS CERTIFICATE OF CANDIDACY
rows.abstract: Section 67 of the Omnibus Election Code is deemed unfair in its treatment of candidates as it exempts candidates for the positions of President and Vice President from resigning from the public office they are currently holding. The bill seeks to do declare all elective officials running for any office other than one he is holding in a permanent capacity as ipso facto resigned from his office upon filing of the certificate of candidacy.

rows.abstract: \"The National Multi-Purpose ID Card Act of 2007\". It also proposes to convert and consolidate all existing government-initiated identification systems into one, integrated and multi-purpose system.

rows.abstract: \"Coconut Emergency Measures Act of 2007\".  The bill seeks to launch an income supplement program for small coconut farmers, tillers, workers and owner-cultivators that will provide them immediate relief from the adverse effects of extremely low prices of copra and husked nuts.

rows.abstract: \"The Real Property Appraisal and Assessment Reform Act of 2007\". rows.author: D013
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING THE LOCAL SANGGUNIANS, EXCEPT THE SANGGUNIANG BARANGAYS THE POWER TO CONDUCT INQUIRIES, IN AID OF LEGISLATION, TO ISSUE SUBPOENA AND TO PUNISH FOR CONTEMPT ANY PERSON WHO REFUSES TO OBEY SUCH PROCESS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 447, 458 AND 468 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to expressly grant the local sangguniang panlalawigans the power to issue subpoena and subpoena duces tecum. Although the power to issue subpoena and subpoena duces tecum is impliedly granted to the local sangguniang panlalawigans by virtue of the statutory grant of delegated legislative power, there is a need to epxressly grant the same because the subpoena power is judicial in character. Allowing local legislative bodies to exercise this power without express statutory basis will impinge on the principle of separation of powers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2007-07-24
